key_insight: For commercial PV-plus-battery dispatch under TOU tariffs, a simple persistence-based MPC nearly matches the best possible annual savings, while the tested SAC reinforcement learning agent fails to beat the no-storage baseline.
engineering_relevance: For deployable energy management systems, this suggests that low-complexity, forecast-light control can deliver most of the economic value without the training and tuning burden of deep RL.
method: MILP with perfect foresight used as an oracle benchmark
MPC with day-ahead persistence forecast as a practical controller
SAC reinforcement learning trained under causal information constraints
evidence_signal: A full-year 2023 evaluation on real commercial PV data found MILP achieved 24.6% annual cost reduction, and MPC recovered 99.2% of that benchmark.
watch_item: The RL result appears sensitive to observability, reward design, and the limited information available in realistic deployment settings.
paper_title: Comparative Evaluation of MILP, MPC, and Reinforcement Learning for Commercial Battery Dispatch Under Time-of-Use Tariffs
